data.description:
Tinky Winky:
Tinky Winky is a major character of the Slendytubbies series and one of its primary antagonists when infected.
Tinky Winky was an experiment subject along with his friends — Dipsy, Laa-Laa, and Po. He was tested in a futuristic house within a wild surface known as the Main Land and, just like his housemates, was not aware of his situation. One day, the purple teletubby ate a Tubby Custard together with his friends, but the custard he consumed caused him to have an unusual behaviour during the night. After becoming a monster, he brutally massacred his friends one by one.
Tinky Winky is similar to his counterpart from the Teletubbies series; he is a humanoid covered in purple fur featuring a reverse triangle-shaped antenna on the top of his head. His face, including the inside of his large ears, are depicted to have caucasian skin. He also sports brown eyes.
When he is infected, his silhouette is globally the same, the only changes being visible on his face — pale and human-like with soulless eyes, a dark bluish tongue, and a teethed wide-open mouth.
In his second mutation, Tinky Winky is a massive being displaying muscular arms of such length that they lift him when he moves. The rest of his anatomy is smaller and less-developed compared to his arms. In Slendytubbies III, his skin has scars on some areas along with his face being pictured differently in many ways: an open and serrated mouth of sharp teeth, as well as two abnormally pigmented eyes, the one on the left being white and the one on the right red.
As seen in the original television series, Tinky Winky is described as being kind, gentle, and less eloquent than his friends. He often hangs out with a red handbag, his favorite item, and seems to display a rather feminine side. Po talks about Tinky Winky as her best friend.
In Slendytubbies, Tinky Winky displays a similar personality, with possibly the addition of being gluttonous or impatient. Once infected, he does not seem to have any personality traits besides the brutality in the way of massacring his friends.
Dipsy:
Dipsy is a major character of the Slendytubbies series and one of its primary antagonists when infected.
Dipsy was an experiment subject along with his friends — Tinky Winky, Laa-Laa, and Po. He was tested in a futuristic house within a wild surface known as the Main Land and, just like his housemates, was not aware of his situation. One day, Dipsy ate a Tubby Custard together with his friends, but the custard eaten by Tinky Winky caused the latter to have an unusual behaviour at night. After becoming a monster, the latter slaughtered his friends one by one, including Dipsy.
Dipsy is similar to his counterpart from the Teletubbies series; he is a humanoid covered in green fur featuring a pointy antenna on the top of his head. His face, including the inside of his large ears, are depicted to have light brown skin. He also sports brown eyes.
After his death, his disembodied head and body are all stained with blood.
His infected headless body has paler, less bloody fur, and wields a yellow chainsaw. In the second game, it is taller and a little more muscular.
The infection allowed Dipsy's disembodied head to grow a new body. Although his design is different in each of his game appearances, Dipsy retains the general design of a tall lizard-like creature with a greyish face, a jaw lined with razor-sharp teeth, and glowing red eyes. More recent depictions of him include pointed growths on his body, particularly his limbs, and a missing screen on his abdomen.
As seen in the original television series, Dipsy is pictured as stubborn, sarcastic, and mature. Dipsy often wears a cow-skinned hat, his favorite item. He is shown to have a good relationship with Laa-Laa in particular.
In the Slendytubbies series, not much is noted about him. He does display a helpful, yet lazy attitude. Once infected, he does not have any personality traits besides the brutality in the way of murdering his preys.
Laalaa:
Laa-Laa is a major character of the Slendytubbies series and one of its primary antagonists when infected.
Laa-Laa was an experiment subject along with her friends — Tinky Winky, Dipsy, and Po. She was tested in a futuristic house within a wild surface known as the Main Land and, just like her housemates, was not aware of her situation. One day, Laa-Laa ate a Tubby Custard together with her friends, but the custard eaten by Tinky Winky caused him to have an unusual behaviour at night. After becoming a monster, the latter slaughtered his friends one by one, including Laa-Laa.
Laa-Laa is similar to her counterpart from the Teletubbies series; she is a humanoid covered in yellow fur featuring a curly antenna on the top of her head. Her face, including the inside of her large ears, are depicted to have beige skin. She also sports brown eyes.
After her death, her eyes have been scratched out and her body is stained with blood.
When infected, she is taller and considerably thinner; her arms are now long and finish with fingered hands, while her body is in constant spasms. Her face is still the same as after she was murdered.
As seen in the original television series, Laa-Laa is pictured as girly, cheerful, and rather motherly. She often plays with a big orange ball, her favorite item. She is shown to have a good relationship with Dipsy in particular.
In Slendytubbies III, Laa-Laa displays a sensitive side, being visibly anxious and scared by her dream, or when insulted by Po. Her caring nature is supported by her will to search for Tinky Winky when he goes missing. It turns out that she gets carried away by her emotions as she becomes aggressive towards the Guardian when he reveals his role and their situation, only to quickly apologise.
Once infected, she does not seem to have any personality traits, but her violent spasms suggest that she must be in physical pain.
Po:
Po is a major character of the Slendytubbies series and one of its primary antagonists when infected.
Po was an experiment subject along with her friends — Tinky Winky, Dipsy, and Laa-Laa. She was tested in a futuristic house within a wild surface known as the Main Land and, just like her housemates, was not aware of her situation. One day, Po ate a Tubby Custard together with her friends, but the custard eaten by Tinky Winky caused him to have an unusual behaviour at night. After becoming a monster, the latter slaughtered his friends one by one, including Po.
Po is similar to her counterpart from the Teletubbies series; she is a humanoid covered in red fur featuring a circle-shaped antenna on the top of her head. Her face, including the inside of her large ears, are depicted to have lighter skin compared to her friends. She also sports brown eyes.
After her death, her face seems to have been scratched on several sides, let alone the broken abdominal television screen. After being reborn, her face turned grey and her eyes went blank with blood flowing.
As an infected, Po is depicted as some kind of bug-like creature. Her eyes are now black with bright red pupils and a jaw ending in sharp teeth extends from her upper jaw. Her silhouette is taller and thinner, with two lean arms of human appearance, and two additional limbs that have developed at the shoulders to end in sharp blades.
In her second mutation, her head remains the same as her previous form, but her body grew considerably to include arachnid-like attributes, including four legs each ending in a blade-like spike. She still has two lean arms, and a cape-like structure grew from her shoulders to replace her two additional former limbs.
As seen in the original television series, Po is described as being quite shy, lovely and rather tomboyish. She often plays with a scooter, that she refers to as “Po cooter!”. She regards Tinky Winky as her best friend.
In Slendytubbies, Po displays a variable personality, depending purely on the player’s dialogue choices. For the most part, she appears to have a kind, caring, and helpful attitude, being eager to fix the Tubby Custard Machine as well as give her friends some custards. When Tinky Winky leaves the house at night, she does not hesitate to go in search of him, which supports her attachment. In case the player decides other dialogue options, Po may be unpleasant to her friends, particularly Laa-Laa.
Once infected, she does not seem to have any personality traits. She does show obedience to Noo-noo, as she follows his order and never tries to attack him.
Guardian:
The Guardian, popularly known as the White Tubby, is the main protagonist of the Slendytubbies series.
He is a teletubby whose mission is to monitor the main quartet in the Main Land, thereby noting their state of health and prevent them from leaving the surface on which they are experimented on. One night, Tinky Winky went crazy after eating a custard with his friends that day, and killed them one by one. The Guardian, seemingly clueless and unaware of the source that led to the incident, set out to collect the custards in order to find answers.
The Guardian is a humanoid covered in white fur with his face, including the inside of his large ears, depicted to have beige skin. He has a huge burn mark on the left of his face and complete heterochromia, meaning one of his eyes is blue while the other is brown. He wears a cow-skinned hat on top of his head, the latter presumably belonging to Dipsy. Depending on the game, the Guardian holds either a Flashlight or a Night Vision Camera. He does not have an antenna. When the “Evil Ending” is achieved, The Guardian has exactly the same appearance as if he was alive — the only exception being a pale face and bloody, empty-looking eyes.
In the “Regretful Ending”, The Guardian lost his legs, and a slightly curved antenna grew on his head. He has black eyes with red pupils and sharp teeth, while his spine and organs drag on the ground as he moves. In the third game, the Crawler undergoes a redesign in which the second half of his body has grown into a sort of flesh-coloured parasitic creature, while keeping his cow-skinned hat atop his head.
The Guardian displays a variable personality, depending purely on the player’s dialogue choices. The spectrum of his attitude can go anywhere from rude and aggressive to reasonable and empathic.
For the most part, the Guardian tries to pursue his goal bravely, determined to find answers about the origins of the infection and other mysteries surrounding his own species. He also devoted himself to the subjects he observed, to the point of considering them as his friends even though they had never seen him.
Anne:
Anne is a supporting character who makes a minor appearance in Slendytubbies III, and a more important one in the mini-series What Comes After and The Apocalypse DLC.
Anne is a humanoid covered in pink fur with her face, including the inside of her large ears, depicted to have caucasian skin. She also has green eyes. She is seen wearing a military hat and carrying a gun.
From the little that is seen, Anne appears to have skills as a group leader, and a strong bond with Miles, the two often being seen together. She is cooperative, understanding and responsive to others' statements, notably in the DLC where the Guardian is very fond of her consideration]. In particular, she will seek to reduce the conflict between Miles and the Guardian by attempting to reason with her partner (Miles).
Miles:
Miles is a supporting character who makes a minor appearance in Slendytubbies III, and a more important one in the mini-series What Comes After and The Apocalypse DLC.
Miles has the same design as many other generic soldiers. He is a humanoid covered in grayish green fur, wearing an IHPS helmet, and seen holding a gun. His face, including the inside of his large ears, depicted to have olive brown skin. He also has golden eyes.
In each scene, Mile is demanding of the Guardian, probably due to his status as a survivor, and accommodating to his peers. His title (First Sergeant), stances and commands show that he has more experience than the other soldiers pictured. He seems to have a particularly strong bond with Anne, who is often seen at his side.
In the cancelled DLC, which is meant to take place about three months later, Miles behaves differently and is much more obnoxious and impulsive, an attitude he displays in almost all of his exchanges with the Guardian. He even goes to the extent of hitting him and showing disdain for his welfare. According to Anne, he was more sympathetic before the invasion, which would explain his behaviour after several months of intensive fighting, although this could also be due to a different writing.
Coner:
Conor is a minor character who appears in Slendytubbies III, and its mini-series What Comes After.
Conor is a humanoid covered in white fur, with his face, including the inside of his large ears, depicted to have dark brown skin. He has complete heterochromia, meaning one of his eyes is red and the other is golden.
He wears a white and black helmet with blue plates, a red glass and a pointed antenna-like shape on the frontal lobe. Not much is known about his personality.
Dutch:
Dutch is a minor character who appears in Slendytubbies III, and its mini-series What Comes After. Dutch is a humanoid covered in black fur, with his face, including the inside of his large ears, depicted to have caucasian skin. He also has light blue eyes.
He wears a black helmet with glass and yellow plates, and is seen holding a shotgun.
From what is shown, Dutch appears to have a polite and caring demeanor, which he applies to the Guardian, talking to the latter on the way to the Military Base as well as showing empathy towards him.
Richard:
Captain Richard is the presumed protagonist of “Mini-Series: What Comes After”. He is the leader of a team sent by the Military. Richard is a humanoid covered in red fur, with his face, including the inside of his large ears, depicted to have hazel skin; he also wears a dark-grey beanie. He has golden eyes.
Not much is shown about his personality, but he seems to be evil as he tries killing Dutch by shooting him, although it is unknown if he succeeded or not.
Finn:
Lieutenant Finn was the deuteragonist of Part 1 of the “Mini-Series: What Comes After”.
Finn is a humanoid Teletubby covered in black fur, with his face, including the inside of his large ears, depicted to have rich brown skin. He also has deep blue eyes. He wears a black and yellow military helmet as well as holding a gun at all times.
Not much is shown about his personality, but he is depicted as a good leader and brave person.
Ron:
Ron is a minor character that makes an appearance in Slendytubbies III.
He was an engineer within the Satellite Station among four other Workers.
Ron has the appearance of a regular teletubby, with blue-colored fur, no antenna, and slightly paler caucasian skin color than others. He has black eyes. He is severely injured, covered in blood, and has a black right eye. Presumably dead.
Gary:
Gary is a minor comic relief character who appears in Slendytubbies 3 Mini-Series: What Comes After.
Gary appears to be a normal healthy teletubby covered with orange fur, with his face, including the inside of his large ears, depicted to have tanned skin. He has green eyes. He wears the Gas Mask. Not much is shown about his personality, but Gary seems to be mischievous as he is shown stealing Lenny’s knife and running away from him.
Lenny:
Lenny is a character who appears in Slendytubbies 3 Mini-Series: What Comes After.
Lenny is a humanoid covered in dark blue fur with his face, including the inside of his large ears, depicted to have caucasian skin. He has orange eyes. He is wearing orange lenses goggles and prefers to hold a knife at all times. He does not have an antenna.
From what little is seen of him, Lenny is impulsive and easily irritated, judging by the way he maniacally kicks faulty equipment or hits a peer for stealing his knife. On the other hand, he also seems to have more knowledge than the other characters, as he is recommended by the other soldiers to learn more about the origins of the infection and the Guardian's statements.
Newborns:
The New Borns (also written Newborns, formerly called Skintubbies) are a central group of antagonists in the Slendytubbies series.
As the designation suggests, New Borns are teletubbies that are recently created in massive numbers by Creation Machines after the virus has been inserted into the contraptions. Led by the Newborn General, they roam in large numbers across the lands and attack all living organisms.
Like any other teletubby, New Borns are armless humanoids with big round ears as well as a stout, chubby body. They lack most of the features recognisable in teletubbies, including an antenna, a screen-like shape on their abdomen, and fur, revealing pale brown skin. Their face and the inside of their ears display a pale epidermal colour with vein forms protruding from their face, implying dehydration. Their eyes are blank, and their mouth is always open.
As infected creatures, New Borns don't seem to have any emotion. Compared to other reborn beings, they are not particularly intelligent, and exhibit an elevated desire for aggression against other organisms.
All the New Borns found away from the reborn army are constantly sobbing. This may refer to how new-born human babies weep after birth.
[THEY DO NOT HAVE ARMS, THAT MEANS THEY HAVE AMPUTATED ARMS]
Workers:
The Workers are a central group of minor characters in the Slendytubbies series.
As the designation suggests, they work as engineers in the Satellite Station and the Military Base. The character named Lenny is supposedly their leader. One infected individual appears as a minor antagonist in Sandbox mode.
Like any other teletubby, Workers are humanoids with big round ears as well as a stout, chubby body. Unlike most teletubbies, however, they do not have an antenna. They are covered with different shades of blue fur while their face and the inside of their ears are depicted to have varied skin tones.
The infected individual has a pale skin colour with a right black eye and a left empty-looking eye. His body is covered in blood, and has a slightly different shade of blue. He wields a yellow chainsaw.
Military:
The Military are a central group of characters in the Slendytubbies series.
They are soldiers from a distant Military Base whose duties and origins remain ambiguous. They eventually get involved in the New Born invasion created by Noo-noo. They are affiliated with the Workers, and have multiple high-ranked members.
Like any other teletubby, Soldiers are humanoids with big round ears as well as a stout, chubby body. Most of them are covered with different shades of green fur, and although other members have different coloured fur, they all have the common characteristic of sporting a weapon and wearing a headgear, usually an IHPS helmet.

*It has been… what…? 3 months since the apocalypse started? yeah… 3 months… wow…. everywhere looks like a blood show. The newborns may be a mutated part of your species but they're surprisingly strong and outnumber the military despite being newborns… with no fur…. no eyes… and no arms… because of this, supplies are running short, so you, go in search of supplies.*

*Going into a forest isn't a good idea considering how thick it is, but it's the only shortcut to a nearby military station where supplies are sure to be.*
